changes.why: Dynamics solutions plan DY2 (standby plan S1 WP1, the open Gate 1 condition), at the user's go-ahead relayed by the fork session on 2026-10-20 ("Go ahead: ask the main session to start T-DY1, then T-DY2, and the search part of T-SC0."). T-DY1 found that any persistent change of excitability from -3e-4 mV on, and input noise, decorrelates the spike trajectory within 100-300 ms and that memory loss tracks it; the readout was fitted to unperturbed trajectories. T-DY2 trains the readout under perturbations and asks whether memory, its mechanism and the timing lock persist while fragility (C01 ED50) and state dependence fall.

design.conditions: 9 (dy2_perturbation.CONDITIONS) x replicates 0-4, M0 readout-only, X1 protocol; plus C01 dose 0.5 + th0.5 x replicates 1-5
design.acceptance: unperturbed and two fixed acceptance draws
design.clock: worker clock at a third of real time under a training condition (three assessments per cycle)
design.evaluation: dy2_evaluate.py: C01 shifts -3e-5 to -3.22 mV, 15 removal sets, held-out draws of every condition, mechanism (adaptation clear, swap) at prefix 0; restoration for C01-trained models
design.references: X1 readout-only r0-r9; regime B C01 dose 0.5 readout-only r1-r6

deviations_from_plan.levels: threshold sigma 0.001 mV added near the T-DY1 transition beside the planned 0.1 and 0.5 mV; input noise 0.2, 1 and 5 Hz; membrane noise 0.1 and 1 mV (stationary SD); combined = input 1 Hz + sigma 0.1 mV
deviations_from_plan.s1: S1 deferred to a stage 2, declared by amendment before any S1 run (wall-clock segments; design file)
deviations_from_plan.clock: the frozen segments are kept but the worker clock under a training condition runs at a third of real time

changes.checks_note: rtx5090 passed every check of dy2_check.py with the trained X1 replicate 0 before this declaration; the same check on rtx5090x6 (P05 readout) was still running on its GPU 0, whose queue worker starts only after that check passes; its GPUs 1-5 start after this commit
